scholarships.name: Institute Merit-cum-Means (MCM) Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: UG students (B.Tech, B.S., B.Des, Dual Degree up to 4th year) whose gross parental income for the previous financial year is at most Rs 5 lakh; first-year merit is judged by JEE (Advanced) AIR or UCEED rank, later years by academic performance. Capped at 25% of sanctioned intake.
scholarships.benefit: Tuition fee exemption plus a cash scholarship that scales with income: Rs 40,000 a year (income up to Rs 1 lakh), Rs 30,000 (Rs 1-3 lakh) or Rs 20,000 (Rs 3-5 lakh). Women students get an extra Rs 10,000 a year Women Merit Scholarship.

sources.title: Merit-cum-Means (MCM) Scholarship — UG, Academic Office IIT Bombay

scholarships.name: Remission of Tuition Fees (family-income based)
scholarships.eligibility: B.Tech, B.S., B.Des and Dual Degree students from the 2016 batch onwards whose gross parental income for the previous financial year does not exceed Rs 5 lakh; an income certificate from a competent authority must be submitted every year.
scholarships.benefit: Full tuition fee waiver when parental income is below Rs 1 lakh a year; two-thirds of the tuition fee waived when income is between Rs 1 lakh and Rs 5 lakh a year.

sources.title: Remission of Fees — UG, Academic Office IIT Bombay

scholarships.name: Free Messing Facilities for SC/ST students
scholarships.eligibility: SC/ST students of B.Tech, B.S., B.Des and Dual Degree (up to 4th year) programmes with gross parental income up to Rs 5 lakh a year; cannot be combined with other government scholarships.
scholarships.benefit: Tuition fee exemption, free messing on the basic menu, exemption from hostel room rent and a pocket allowance of Rs 500 a month for 10 months a year; women students additionally receive a Rs 10,000 a year Women Merit Scholarship.

sources.title: Facilities of Free Messing (for SC/ST category students) — UG, Academic Office IIT Bombay

scholarships.name: Tuition Fee Exemption for SC/ST/PwD students
scholarships.eligibility: All UG students admitted under the SC, ST or PwD categories, irrespective of family income.
scholarships.benefit: The statutory tuition fee (Rs 1,00,000 per semester for 2026-27 entrants) is not charged; all other academic, hostel and mess charges still apply.

scholarships.name: Named Scholarships (alumni and donor endowed)
scholarships.eligibility: UG students meeting the same merit-cum-means test as the MCM scheme: gross parental income up to Rs 5 lakh a year, with JEE (Advanced) AIR / UCEED rank in first year and academic performance thereafter. Administered by the Dean, Alumni & Corporate Relations.
scholarships.benefit: Scholarship amounts vary by endowment; each named award is funded by IIT Bombay alumni or well-wishers and is granted for the programme duration subject to continued eligibility.

sources.title: Named Scholarships — UG, Academic Office IIT Bombay

scholarships.name: Government scholarships via the National Scholarship Portal (Central Sector, Centrally Sponsored and State schemes)
scholarships.eligibility: Depends on the individual scheme (category, family income and state of domicile); IIT Bombay directs students to check the National Scholarship Portal, noting that some government schemes pay more than institute scholarships.
